name: Swiss / International
fit: Grid-led, typographic clarity, strong hierarchy, little ornament.
surfaces: Strict grid, generous margins or modular columns, hairline rules.
type: Grotesk sans dominance; asymmetric or modular type scale.
color: Limited palette; black/white/gray plus one signal color.
depth: Flat. Hierarchy from type and space, not shadow.
bestFor: Docs-heavy products, design tools, brand-forward B2B.
avoid: Soft blobs, skeuomorphism, playful clay shapes.
adapt: Keep grid and type clarity; change the signal color and family.
